title: Rural Electricity Arrived Long Before Clean Cooking Did
hook: Rural areas got electricity. Cooking never caught up.
closing: Wired up isn't the same as cooked up.
question: Gas, electric, or fire at home?

segments.say: Rural electricity access jumped to 85 percent by 2024 -- most of the world's countryside finally got wired up.
So 44 percent of rural homes are still cooking over open fire or charcoal.
Overall electricity use per person climbed to 3,558 kilowatt-hours a year.
